desc: Derive the prefix-potential reformulation and necessary-and-sufficient contracted-graph feasibility condition.
Characterize pairwise conflicts and establish that pairwise feasibility implies global feasibility.
Correct the dynamic 2D range-max packed inner-tree indexing and validate same-sign crossing detection.
Compute every `prev[i]`, the maximum earlier conflicting trip index, including endpoint and same-sign proper-crossing conflicts.
Answer interval queries using range maximum over `prev`.
Verify correctness, time complexity, memory usage, edge cases, and public sample tests.
